TAKEN FOR A BAT SPACE

TAKEN FOR A BAT SPACE is An experiment built by a collective of international designers reclaiming space together. Through collective building, installations, and performances, it staged a cultural shelter to experience and discuss rewilding processes and beyond human spectrum sensing. It was activated during Dutch Design Week 2025 and hosted by ReWild Farm.

With: Dora Heller Russel, Tymon Zaniewski, Celeste Zion
